race.comment: FONTALICIOUS (7) tackled a stronger race last start at Sandown Hillside and faded to finish last after setting a slow speed, beaten for a turn of foot there. Happy to forgive that one, her form prior was rock solid for this and she should be fitter for it regardless. MIDNIGHT DEVIL (4) can mix his form a bit but was good last start at Moe when just nosed out. He'll land in the first couple and give a sight. BOLD PRINT (1) hasn't really fired his past couple on turf but back to synthetic here should suit, his best is good enough to win. SUPERLIV (5) didn't fire fresh but can improve while HELLUVA BARTY (2) could sneak into the minor money.
